message: The other day, as we prepped for a storm, my grandkids were more interested in building a fort out of couch cushions than anything else. I had to smile as they declared it their ‘hurricane headquarters.’ While they were busy creating their own little adventure, I quietly tucked away some extra snacks and flashlights. Sometimes, the best way to prepare is to let the kids have their fun while you cover the basics. Who knew storm prep could double as a fort-building contest? 🏰
